title: Stabilizer Induced Module Calculation
body_html:
Stabilizer Induced Module Calculation

The evaluation map identifies the \(K_{M,+}\)-isotypic part of the induced stabilizer representation with \(S(b)^{b_C}\), and the induced module from \(S K_{M,+}\) to \(\Delta^0K_{M,0+}\) is isomorphic to the product Heisenberg-Weil representation \(\kappa_M\).
proof_html: This aggregates the stabilizer evaluation map calculation supercuspidal_theta.stabilizer_evaluation_map and the kappa factor Hom triviality calculation supercuspidal_theta.kappa_factor_hom_triviality. The first identifies the \(K_{M,+}\)-isotypic part of the induced stabilizer representation with \(S(b)^{b_C}\) and then with the product Heisenberg-Weil type. The second supplies the layer-by-layer one-dimensional Hom calculation for the Yu \(\kappa\)-factors.
